meeting.title: Implementation working session
meeting.summary: Working session on the semantic layer. Reviewed the first dashboard rebuild against the existing report and found a small discrepancy in an aggregation that traces back to a duplicated join. Agreed to move the logic into a proper mart model with tests rather than patching the dashboard query. Next session will cover the executive dashboard once the mart lands.
action_items: Split the aggregation logic into a staging model and a mart model with tests
Re-run the side-by-side comparison once the mart is in place
Schedule the next working session for the executive dashboard
key_decisions: Aggregation logic moves into a tested mart model instead of a dashboard-level fix
meeting.notes: Ad hoc session, no calendar event attached, so attendees and speaker names didn't resolve. The customer isn't named anywhere on the recording — this one will need to be assigned manually.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Let's compare the rebuilt dashboard against your existing report side by side. Most tiles match, but this one aggregation is off by a bit.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I see it. That number's been slightly weird for a while honestly. Any idea why?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Looks like a duplicated join fanning out the rows — the old query masks it with a distinct further down. I'd rather not carry that forward.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Agreed, don't replicate the bug. Put it in a real model?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Exactly — a staging model plus a mart model with tests, and the dashboard becomes a thin view. Then we re-run the side-by-side and it should tie out cleanly.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: I'll build the staging and mart models this week. Next session we do the executive dashboard?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Perfect. I'll get the next working session on the calendar once the mart lands. Good progress today.
